🪔 LOS ANGELES DIWALI FEST 2026 🪔
Food • Music • Culture • Shopping • CelebrationBIH Events presents Los Angeles’ Biggest Diwali Cultural Celebration — DIWALI FEST 2026!
Join us on Saturday, November 7th at Academy LA for a spectacular evening celebrating the Festival of Lights in the heart of Los Angeles.
We’re transforming the Academy LA outdoor patio into a vibrant Diwali festival filled with music, food, culture, lights, shopping, entertainment, and incredible energy.
This is more than a party — it’s a full Diwali festival experience designed for families, friends, couples, and communities to come together and celebrate one of India’s most beautiful festivals.

✨ WHAT TO EXPECT🎶 Music Festival Stage
🎤 Live Performances & Entertainment
🎧 DJs + Bollywood Music
💃 Dance Performances
🍛 Indian Street Food & Food Vendors
🛍️ Clothing, Jewelry & Shopping Vendors
📸 Diwali-Themed Photo Booths & Photo Ops
🪔 Beautiful Diwali Décor & Lights
🎉 Massive Outdoor Cultural Celebration

⚠️ PLEASE NOTE: 21+ MUSIC & BAR AREA
While Diwali Dhamaka is an all-ages festival, access to the Music Stage & Bar Area is strictly 21+.
🍸 Alcohol will be served in this designated area, and children/minors will not be permitted inside. A valid government-issued photo ID will be required for entry to the 21+ area.
Come dressed in your favorite Indian / ethnic attire and experience an evening filled with colors, music, food and the spirit of Diwali.

🌎 EVERYONE IS WELCOMEYou do not have to be Indian to attend!
